name: my-gobbler

scripts.build: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:contracts && npm run build -w @gobbler/frontend && tsc -p apps/backend/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:contracts && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:architecture && npm run check:contracts && tsc --noEmit -p apps/backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/frontend/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:check && docker compose -f deploy/compose.yaml up -d --build

description: A student-built Virginia Tech campus companion.
